layout.name: brightness
layout.note: per-dot brightness: skin and shirt 0.70 to 0.95 (dimmer just under the jaw), hair strands 0.78 to 1, feature lines 0.88 to 1

units: figure height = 1.0. y = 0 at the crop line (mid-chest), y = 1 at the top of the hair. x to the viewer's right, z toward the viewer. Yaw axis at x = 0, z = 0.
